title: Cross-Process Outcome Ledger + Neural Feedback Bus
brief: Close architect risk #1 (outcome data starvation). Every print-to-program pipeline run, consensus decision, and machine job must emit a structured CrossProcessOutcomeEvent that lands in CrossProcessOutcomeStore. Add a feedback bus so downstream learning engines (CrossProcessNeuralLearningEngine, BayesianCalibrate, LoRA trainers) subscribe instead of poll.

shipped.design: replay() overload preserves legacy `replay(handler)` callback contract via 3 typed signatures: replay() returns full chronological array, replay(limit) returns last-N tail in chronological order, replay(handler) invokes per-event in chronological order returning void. replay(arg) where arg is neither undefined/number/function throws original `/handler must be a function/` message (legacy test at line 531 still green). replayJob filters by jobId equality, sorts ts-asc. replaySince filters by ts >= timestamp (lex compare correct for canonical ISO-8601), sorts ts-asc. streamReplayFromDisk uses fs.access() pre-check (clean ENOENT → 0 return), then createReadStream + readline.createInterface for true line-by-line iteration (never readFile-into-memory); limit causes early break, malformed lines skipped, wrong-schemaVersion records skipped, jobId/since filters applied per record. ENOENT returns 0; missing storePath throws; invalid opts throw with descriptive messages.

ALL findings fixed in same commit per always-close-out rule: (P0) test §4 phase-2 had a tautological `expect(transitioned).toBe(true)` after recordOutcome on same-kind — reconciled by removing the dead block; the real transition-asserting line is now `recordOutcome(pendingId, {kind:'failure'})` with comment citing CrossProcessOutcomeStore.ts:299; (P1-engine-A) clearObservations() docstring claimed it reset all fields but skipped observationBufferCap — fixed by adding the reset and updating docstring; (P1-engine-B) enableOutcomeObservation() applied bufferCap AFTER idempotent early-return so a re-subscribe with new cap silently dropped — fixed by moving the bufferCap clamp BEFORE the early-return; (P2-engine) unbounded dedup Set growth — bounded at PRIORITY_4 × bufferCap × DEDUP_SET_MAX_MULTIPLIER (40,000 ids ≈ 1.5 MB at defaults; covers ~2 years of typical shop-floor flow); evicts oldest half FIFO via insertion-order iteration when high-water-mark exceeded. shipped.design: Subscribe pattern follows the existing CrossProcessNeuralLearningEngine.enableAutoTrain()/disableAutoTrain() shape — symmetric enable/disable methods, isObserving* probe, ObservationStatus snapshot, getObservationBuffer per-CAM accessor with defensive copy. Bus callback is fire-and-forget: O(1) amortized per call (push + Set.add + cap-check are constant; bufferCap-overflow shift is O(bufferCap) but bounded). Per-CAM resolution checks request_summary.cam_system first (preferred — set by CAM bridges) then record.process (defensive — currently disjoint from PRIORITY_4 because OUTCOME_PROCESSES=[mill,lathe,wedm], but kept as future-proofing for when CAM-specific process slugs land). Heavy training stays under explicit operator control via the pre-existing trainAll() / trainFromFiles() — bus only observes.

units.design: FeedbackBusEngine (subscribe/publish/wildcard/error-isolated fan-out) was already built. Three subscribers already coexisted on the bus: CrossProcessNeuralLearningEngine (U-NN-LOOP03, outcome.recorded → auto-train buffer), OutcomeDriftCalibrationBridgeEngine (U-CN06, outcome.completed → drift + calibration + concept-shift), and 4 secondary subscribers (ConformalPredictionLog, TribalKnowledgeOutcomeBridge, OutcomeReplayBufferBridge, OutcomeEpisodicMemoryBridge). What was missing: the THIRD spec-mandated subscriber. CAMLoRAAdapterTrainerEngine now subscribes to outcome.recorded with a lightweight idempotent observer that buffers per-CAM samples for the next batched trainAll() — heavy retraining stays under explicit operator control. Per-CAM bucket resolves via request_summary.cam_system (preferred) OR record.process (defensive). Dedup by record.id covers replay; Set growth bounded at PRIORITY_4 × bufferCap × 10. Per-CAM ring buffer FIFO-evicts on overflow; counters stay monotonic.
